pages.text: Put raw food in the $(item)galley stove$()'s frying pan (any food that can be cooked). Watch it brown, and take it off when the smoke turns white. Leave it too long and it chars.
The $(item)grog barrel$() fills a glass bottle or a bucket. Each drink makes you drunker. Too many and the world spins, and you'll be sick: catch it in an empty bucket.
